CLI: wipe and regenerate `<think>` blocks and `instruction` text for recorded
trajectories. Two flavours, picked by `--dry-run`: --dry-run Generate in
memory, print an old-vs-new Markdown report, write nothing. (no --dry-run)
Bulk-write: overwrite the affected fields in `trajectory.json` in place.
`--instructions` / `--thoughts` narrow what gets regenerated (default: both).
`--sample N` picks N trajectories spanning Path A and Path B for review. Path
A trajectories (mind2web, in `trajectories/task_*/`) skip the instruction
generator — their instructions come from the GPT recorder with a different
provenance and would not benefit from the test-source-based prompt. They still
get new thoughts. Run from the repo root: .venv-pipeline/bin/python -m
cua.pipeline.regenerate_supervision --dry-run --sample 5

positional arguments:
  path                  trajectories root (default: trajectories/)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --dry-run             generate in memory and print Markdown report, no
                        writes
  --sample SAMPLE       limit to N sampled trajectories (0 = all)
  --instructions        regenerate the trajectory.instruction field
  --thoughts            regenerate every steps[].thought field
  --report-path REPORT_PATH
                        also write the Markdown report to this file
  --verbose             enable INFO logging
